THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-0: I’ll find great joy in this bullet between your eyes.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-1: For what purpose? Nevermind, I don’t care.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-0: ’ll find great joy in this bullet betw-
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-1: Heard it before. Come back with new material.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.2-0: It’s been fun, but I’m ending this game here!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.2-1: Then forfeit or die, that’s the only way this ends.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.3-1: I’ll see you there, long from now.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.3-2: I don’t plan on going there.
PAEl.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-0.ancient: Such senseless violence, there is no need.
PAEl.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-1.char: I’m boOOOaaaAArrrrrd... let me have this.
PAEl.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-2.ancient: Calm yourself, take a piece of me.
PAEl.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-0.ancient: There are many sources of joy, why must you kill?
PAEl.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-1.char: It was the first thing I thought of, why?
PAEl.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-2.ancient: You lack empathy, child. I am concerned.
PAEl.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.2-0.ancient: You are back in your endless quest. Let my body serve your entertainment.
NONUPEIPE.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-0.cha: Nice place you got here. I’m gonna steal some stuff.
NONUPEIPE.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-1.anc: You may have it. Anything to aid the Architect’s fall.
NONUPEIPE.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-2.cha: … I wanted to steal it though... :(
NONUPEIPE.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-0.anc: Every little fishie in your arsenal deserves the finest equipments.
NONUPEIPE.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-1.cha: Just give it to the orange one. It’s my favorite.
NONUPEIPE.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.2-0.anc: Let me bedazzle your bowl, mercenary!
DARV.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-0.ancient: What’re you looking for? I have anything you could want.
DARV.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-1.char: How about a time machine? I wish I could go back to before I saw your ugly face.
DARV.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-0.ancient: These items are from a time looong before ya’.
DARV.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-1.char: I don’t care how old they are. Are they powerful?
DARV.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-2.ancient: Figures you’d’nt care about it. They’re plenty strong.
DARV.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.2-0.ancient: Just as I’d expect. You want a looksie at my wares.
OROBAS.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-0.ancien: You are glass?! I am eye! This is fun!
OROBAS.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-1.char: Not fun enough. I’m looking for better fun.
OROBAS.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-0.ancien: Maybe.. glass can have calm fun today..!
OROBAS.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-1.char: HA! No. I’m gonna kill things.
VAKUU.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-0.ancient: [font_size=22](This one looks like a sucker...)[/font_size] Care to make a deal?
VAKUU.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-1.char: I know you’re evil and gonna ruin my life with your deal. Sure.
VAKUU.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-0.ancient: Your face is fragile. So is mine. We are alike in that way.
VAKUU.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-1.char: Your business pitch sucks, I just think it’s silly to accept whatever you offer me.
VAKUU.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-2.ancient: Whatever gets your signature on the paper...
VAKUU.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.2-0.ancient: You cannot achieve true power without me.
TEZCATARA.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-0.anc: Come, dear. You need not worry you extinguish me.
TEZCATARA.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-1.cha: Give me something good and I won’t.
TEZCATARA.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-0.anc: A robot not of The Architect’s design? Who created you, little one?
TEZCATARA.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-1.cha: I made myself. Easy as that.
TEZCATARA.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.2-0.anc: Love, let’s get you set up for mayhem.
TANX.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-0.ancient: BULLETS ARE BORING! FEEL THE THRILL OF A SWORD FOR ONCE!
TANX.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-1.char: Can I prove to you they’re not?
TANX.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.0-2.ancient: YES! SHOW ME THE POWER OF YOUR GUNS!
TANX.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-1.char: You... don’t want to fight first? I kinda wanted to.
TANX.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.1-2.ancient: I’D NEVER FORGET!!! FIGHT! FIGHT! FIGHT!
TANX.talk.AQUARIUM-AQUARIUM.2-0.ancient: GUNSLINGER! FIGHT ME! CLAIM A PRIZE!
